items.title: DTE Energy Links Proposed Rate Freeze to Data Center Projects in Earnings Call
items.dek: The utility tied a potential two-year electric rate freeze to the start of a major Oracle facility and other large-load approvals, with its data center pipeline holding steady at multiple gigawatts.
